brief: On August 18, 2026, the SEC proposed Regulation Crypto Assets (Reg CA), a 402-page rule creating a $5 million startup exemption, a two-tier $20 million/$75 million fundraising exemption, and Rule 400, a conditional safe harbor under which a covered investment contract ceases to exist, and its underlying token is no longer a security, once the issuer's essential managerial efforts end. The rule remains non-exclusive of Howey-test arguments. This followed Treasury's August 17 proposed rule implementing GENIUS Act Section 3 stablecoin-issuer definitions ahead of the Act's January 18, 2027 effective date, and preceded the CFTC's August 20 Innovation Advisory Committee meeting. The note reads this cluster as executive agencies building a de facto regulatory framework while the CLARITY Act stays stalled in Congress. Solana's institutional distribution expanded: Schwab plans to add SOL as its third crypto asset, Western Union launched a Solana-USDPT Visa card in 37 markets, and MoneyGram linked Solana apps to nearly 500,000 cash locations. On-chain RWA, xStocks and Raydium volumes hit new highs even as SOL price stays below early-2026 levels. The XRP Ledger's 3.3.0 upgrade added privacy, batch settlement and sponsored fees that preserve indirect XRP demand, though RLUSD, not XRP, has settled institutional pilots to date.
